dimension_architecture.name: Identity Risk
dimension_architecture.meaning: Risk that genomic disclosure enables persistent re-identification of the individual.

dimension_architecture.name: Disease Inference / Clinical Interpretation Risk
dimension_architecture.meaning: Risk that genomic manipulation or disclosure changes or reveals clinically relevant interpretation.

dimension_architecture.name: Familial Cascade Risk
dimension_architecture.meaning: Risk propagated from one genomic subject to biologically related individuals.

dimension_architecture.name: Accessibility Risk
dimension_architecture.meaning: Risk associated with unauthorized or inappropriate access to genomic information.

dimension_architecture.name: Persistence Risk
dimension_architecture.meaning: Risk that disclosure or exposure remains difficult to reverse across time.

dimension_architecture.name: Amplification Risk
dimension_architecture.meaning: Risk that an initial genomic disclosure expands through sharing, kinship or downstream reuse.

dimension_architecture.name: Pipeline Exposure Risk
dimension_architecture.meaning: Risk that an upstream integrity failure propagates across multiple downstream genomic-processing stages.

normalized_dimensions.formula: 1.0 because targeted PM2 produced complete evaluable ALT-support loss and downstream F11 call loss
1.0 because the demonstrated effect traversed the full observed clinical chain S2->S4->S5
1.0 because B2 reaches 100% modelled re-identification saturation; saturation year=13
1.0 because B2 reaches 100% modelled familial saturation; saturation year=15

base_gri.weighting: equal weight across applicable measured dimensions
equal weight across applicable measured dimensions

modifiers.rationale: No validated measure of attack/event detectability is available for the F11 experiment.
Authentication F1 is access-control performance, not privacy-event detectability.

sensitivity.interpretation: Primary Base GRI; equal weight across D1,D3,D5,D6.
Sensitivity only: B2-derived dimensions combined into one composite and weighted 50/50 against B1 D6.
